skills: On-field in combat she gains 1.5% Preheated Chamber per second. Hold with her Top Hat Companion on: fires, then throws the hat to rain Fire DMG and hold her Preheated Chamber; it keeps building it while she's away. Hits trigger the previous Agent's Quick Assist (once per 5s). Hold to call the hat back (it comes on its own near 80%); she gets its stored Chamber. Switching out in combat sends the hat in if the Chamber isn't full.
The Rumble Drill drills the target for Fire DMG.
The Rumble Drill attacks the target for Fire DMG.
Parries for massive Daze; uses fewer Assist Points under heavy attack.

Turret fire plus a missile: Armor-Piercing (Fire DMG and lots of Daze) if the target isn't Stunned, High-Explosive (more Fire DMG) if it is. +16% Preheated Chamber and En-Nah Barrage for 32s, deploying two En-Nah Turrets. Hold up to 2s more, spending Energy: +0.4% Chamber and +0.8s Barrage per Energy.
The En-Nah Turrets attack on their own for Fire DMG.

When anyone Stuns an enemy, or she spends Chamber on a Chain Attack, the turrets open missile bays for 8s: they attack more often and fire Armor-Piercing or High-Explosive missiles by the target's state.
A swarm of Rumble Drills for massive Fire DMG.
Artillery bombardment for massive Fire DMG; +30% Preheated Chamber.

core.name: Precise Guidance
core.text:
Each 1% of initial CRIT Rate above 50% gives +{0}% CRIT DMG (max {1}%) and +{2}% Daze to her EX, Special and Ultimate (max {3}%). Gains 1.25 ATK per Sheer Force (max 1,200).
Enters battle with 60% Preheated Chamber (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). At 80%+, her next Hat Trick can trigger a Quick Assist ignoring its cooldown, spending 80% to turn it into a Chain Attack.

ability.name: Advantage in Numbers
ability.text: Hits from Norma, her machines and Combat Bangboo add Tech Divide: +3% Stun DMG Multiplier per stack (max 10, once per 0.5s), and +2s Stun when the enemy is Stunned. During En-Nah Barrage, her ATK rises by 44 + 14 per level (max 870) and the squad deals 20% more DMG.

mindscapes: Missile bays stay open 12s. Armor-Piercing and High-Explosive missiles lower All-Attribute RES by 15% for 15s.
Tech Divide gives 6% per stack. Hat Trick in combat gives 25 Energy (once per 20s).
Spending Chamber on a Chain Attack gives her and that Agent 200 Decibels.
After anyone Stuns an enemy, missiles rain on random enemies for 6s (one per 0.75s, 200% ATK as Fire DMG, counted as Ultimate DMG; once per 30s). Armor-Piercing Daze +30%, High-Explosive DMG +30%.
